tagline: 雅西卡旁轴相机，1972 年发布
description: 雅西卡于1972年推出的旁轴相机。快门速度horizontal curtain focal plane, mechanical, 1/1000 to 1 sec and B。

specs.曝光测光: TTL stop down, weighted, CdS, two lights in viewfinder (up: overexposed, down underexposed, both: ok) from 12 ASA to 1600 ASA
specs.快门: horizontal curtain focal plane, mechanical, 1/1000 to 1 sec and B
specs.闪光灯: Hot and syncro-x, X at 1/60, MF at 1/30. (1/90s on X model)
specs.电池: Two Mallory PX-640 or equivalent 1.35V Mercury batteries (PX-28 6.2V Silver Oxide 4SR44 on X model)
specs.英文简介: The Yashica TL Electro was introduced in 1972, and was one of the Yashica TL series cameras.
